data.long_meaning: Ihnika is a Sanskrit and Hindu name which means 'Radiant, Joyful'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ihna', which means 'joy'. The name is often given to girls as a symbol of happiness and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. The name Ihnika carries the meaning “Joyful, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ihnika usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ihnika total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
